name: MAX
description: MAX messenger (max.ru) channel for OpenClaw: private and group chats over webhook or long polling; media, voice messages with transcription and voice replies; inline keyboards and command menus; message edits and pins; several bot accounts

disableAudioPreflight.description: Do not transcribe a captionless voice message to look for a configured mention pattern in this group.

botToken.description: MAX Bot API token, or a SecretRef to it ({ source: env|file|exec|store, provider, id }) resolved by the gateway before the account starts. Alternatives: tokenFile, MAX_BOT_TOKEN (default account).

dmPolicy.description: Who may message the bot in direct chats (default pairing). Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

groupPolicy.description: Which group chats the bot answers in (default allowlist: only chats listed in groups). Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

mentionPatterns.description: Where core mention patterns (messages.groupChat / agent groupChat mentionPatterns) apply in MAX groups: mode allow (default) or deny, with allowIn / denyIn group chat ids.

transport.description: Update transport. Default: webhook when webhookUrl is set, otherwise polling. MAX does not serve long polling while a webhook subscription exists.

webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL (port 443, trusted CA) MAX posts updates to; its path is served on the gateway HTTP server.

webhookSecret.description: X-Max-Bot-Api-Secret value, 5-256 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -. Prefer webhookSecretFile; generated and kept in the account state file when neither is set. Accepts a SecretRef.

webhookSecretFile.description: File holding the webhook secret (like tokenFile).

webhookPath.description: Gateway route path when it differs from the webhookUrl pathname (default: webhookUrl pathname, else /max/webhook).

streaming.description: Core streaming settings; streaming.mode wins over streamMode. "progress" shows one turn-status message edited while the agent works (streaming.progress: label, labels, toolProgress, commandText, maxLines, maxLineChars) and deleted once the answer landed; "partial"/"block" as streamMode. Default off.

webhookQueue.description: Webhook queue. mode "durable" (default): every accepted update is written to the plugin state directory before MAX gets its 200, so a gateway restart or crash does not lose it; handled updates are deleted. mode "memory": the 0.7 in-memory queue. maxPending (default 5000) bounds accepted but unhandled updates; when full, overflow "reject" (default) answers 503 so MAX redelivers later, "drop" acknowledges and drops.

maxEventAgeMinutes.description: Messages, edits, button presses and bot_started older than this many minutes (by MAX event time) are skipped instead of answered, so after a long outage the bot does not reply to hours-old messages (webhook, the queue recovered after a restart and long polling). Default 60; 0 answers any age.

logMessagePreview.description: Debug logs of inbound messages include a 50-character text preview, for debugging. Off by default: logs carry the message type, text length and ids, never message text, captions or transcripts.

mediaMaxCount.description: Most media attachments (images, stickers, video, audio, files) downloaded per inbound message (default 12), forwarded ones included; the agent gets a note about the rest. Size is limited separately by mediaMaxMb. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

actionScope.description: Chats message-tool actions (send, sendAttachment, sticker, edit, delete, pin, unpin) may act in. admitted (default): the current chat, owner requests and chats admitted by dmPolicy/allowFrom/pairing and groupPolicy/groups; current: non-owner turns only in their own chat; off: no plugin check. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

notify.description: Default push notification for sent messages (MAX notify, default true). false sends silently; an explicit value of the call (core silent flag, channelData.max.notify) wins. MAX channels always notify. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

disableLinkPreview.description: Default: send messages without link previews (MAX disable_link_preview). Unset: previews on, except tool summaries (verbose mode), which go without them; a set value applies to all sends. channelData.max.disableLinkPreview overrides it per message. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

apiBaseUrl.description: MAX Bot API base URL (default https://platform-api2.max.ru), e.g. a test stand; a path prefix is kept. https only; http is accepted just for loopback hosts, so the bot token never travels unencrypted. A bad value stops the account at start with an error. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value.

httpProxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy for all outbound MAX traffic of the account: Bot API calls, file uploads and media downloads, e.g. http://user:pass@proxy.example:3128. MAX TLS (Russian Trusted CA included) is verified inside the tunnel; loopback targets bypass the proxy. Credentials are never logged. Named accounts inherit the channel-level value; "" turns an inherited proxy off. Accepts a SecretRef (e.g. when the URL carries credentials).

commands.description: Bot commands registered on start via PATCH /me/commands (replaces the whole list, max 32).

name.label: Account name
name.help: Display name of the account. Own: not inherited by named accounts.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: false at channel level disables all accounts; in an account, disables that account.

markdown.label: Markdown tables
markdown.help: markdown.tables: how tables in agent replies are sent (MAX has no native tables). Not set: by width, a table up to 36 monospace columns as a monospace block, a wider one as bullets. bullets: one bullet per cell under the bold row label; code: monospace block; block: same as code; off: raw Markdown.

botToken.label: Bot token
botToken.help: MAX Bot API token or a SecretRef to it. Own.

tokenFile.label: Token file
tokenFile.help: Absolute path to a regular file with the bot token. Own.

dmPolicy.label: DM policy
dmPolicy.help: Who may write in private dialogs: pairing (default), allowlist, open or disabled.

allowFrom.label: Allowed DM senders
allowFrom.help: MAX user ids allowed in private dialogs; "*" allows anyone (required with open).

groupAllowFrom.label: Allowed group senders
groupAllowFrom.help: User ids allowed in admitted groups when the group has no own allowFrom.

groupPolicy.label: Group policy
groupPolicy.help: Which groups the bot answers in: allowlist (default), open or disabled.

groups.label: Groups
groups.help: Allowed groups and per-group settings, keyed by chat id or "*".

mentionPatterns.label: Mention pattern scope
mentionPatterns.help: Where core mention patterns apply in MAX groups: mode allow|deny, allowIn, denyIn.

transport.label: Transport
transport.help: polling or webhook; default webhook when webhookUrl is set, else polling. Own.

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.help: Public HTTPS URL MAX posts updates to. Own.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.help: Secret MAX sends with every webhook call; generated when unset. Plain value or SecretRef. Own.

webhookSecretFile.label: Webhook secret file
webhookSecretFile.help: File with the webhook secret (regular file, not a symlink). Own.

webhookPath.label: Webhook path
webhookPath.help: Gateway route path; default: the path of webhookUrl, else /max/webhook. Own.

historyLimit.label: Group history limit
historyLimit.help: Read by OpenClaw core: recent turns of a group session the embedded agent runtime keeps in the prompt.

dmHistoryLimit.label: DM history limit
dmHistoryLimit.help: Read by OpenClaw core: recent turns of a private-dialog session kept in the prompt.

dms.label: Per-user DM settings
dms.help: dms.<userId>.historyLimit, read by OpenClaw core before dmHistoryLimit.

textChunkLimit.label: Text chunk limit
textChunkLimit.help: Characters per outgoing message; values above MAX's 4000 (the default) are capped.

blockStreaming.label: Block streaming (no effect)
blockStreaming.help: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect in MAX. Use streamMode or streaming.mode "block".

streamMode.label: Stream mode
streamMode.help: off (default); partial: one draft edited while the answer streams; block: core block replies.

streaming.label: Streaming
streaming.help: Core streaming config; streaming.mode (off, partial, block, progress) wins over streamMode; streaming.progress configures turn status.

blockStreamingCoalesce.label: Block streaming coalesce (no effect)
blockStreamingCoalesce.help: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect in MAX. Core reads streaming.block.coalesce.

responsePrefix.label: Response prefix
responsePrefix.help: Prefix of agent replies, applied by OpenClaw core ("auto": agent name).

mediaMaxMb.label: Media size limit, MB
mediaMaxMb.help: Size limit for downloaded and uploaded media (default 20).

webhookQueue.label: Webhook queue
webhookQueue.help: mode durable (default) or memory, maxPending (5000), overflow reject (default) or drop.

maxEventAgeMinutes.label: Max event age, minutes
maxEventAgeMinutes.help: Skip messages, edits, button presses and bot starts older than this (default 60); 0: no limit.

logMessagePreview.label: Log message preview
logMessagePreview.help: Add a 50-character text preview to debug logs (default false).

mediaMaxCount.label: Media per message
mediaMaxCount.help: Media attachments downloaded per incoming message, forwards included (default 12).

markSeen.label: Mark as read
markSeen.help: Mark incoming messages as read (default true).

actionScope.label: Action scope
actionScope.help: Chats the message tool may act in: admitted (default), current or off.

notify.label: Notify
notify.help: Push notifications for sends; false: silent (not possible in channels).

apiBaseUrl.label: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.help: Bot API base URL; https only, http just for loopback.

httpProxy.label: HTTP proxy
httpProxy.help: HTTP(S) proxy for all MAX traffic; "" in an account turns an inherited proxy off. Plain value or SecretRef.

actions.label: Message tool actions
actions.help: false turns an action off: send, edit, delete, sticker, sendAttachment, pin, unpin.

groups.*.requireMention.label: Require mention
groups.*.requireMention.help: Answer only when the bot is mentioned, replied to or its button is pressed (default true).

groups.*.tools.label: Tool policy
groups.*.tools.help: Core tool policy for this group.

groups.*.skills.label: Skills
groups.*.skills.help: Skills a turn in this group may load; [] for none.

groups.*.enabled.label: Enabled
groups.*.enabled.help: false: ignore this group under any groupPolicy.

groups.*.allowFrom.label: Allowed senders
groups.*.allowFrom.help: Senders allowed in this group (overrides groupAllowFrom).

groups.*.systemPrompt.label: System prompt
groups.*.systemPrompt.help: Extra system prompt for turns in this group.

groups.*.disableAudioPreflight.label: Disable audio preflight
groups.*.disableAudioPreflight.help: Do not transcribe captionless voice messages to look for a mention (default false).

accounts.help: Named bot accounts; each inherits channel-level options except its own token, name and webhook.

commands.label: Bot commands
commands.help: Commands registered in MAX (up to 32; name up to 64 characters without /, description up to 128).
